title: Prove analytic D6 rank-six capacity after four orthogonal punctures
body:
## Summary

```diff
 D6 large 33-root axis, FOUR orthogonal punctures, binary support rank<=6
- capacity 18 depends on complete six-space censuses
+ analytic affine-quadratic proof with exact structural binding
+ equality classification and actual fixed-P112 attaining 18-label support
```

Add only `research/d6-punctured-capacity 18/`. PR3267 already proved the numerical capacity 18. This supplies a direct proof of that dependency: every 20-root affine section meets the puncture in at least two roots. Arbitrary ambient support spaces and the exceptional root are included. The finite binding covers all 7,560 ordered orthogonal pairs and all 120 canonical punctures.

Four punctures are required. This does not apply to 31-root fibers with two punctures, and asserts no new shortening threshold, caller, full C5, supplier, selected-frontier update or kappa. Concurrent mixed5/5/6 cut40 and A2 joint32 work is separate and unused. Credit PR3267, David Arias's quadratic model, the root-simplex/E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo and DreamingOfClouds/PR3154. Exact predecessor proof/receipt bytes and source authentication are retained. Open next questions are in README/TASK.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3267's18capacity was supplied by 896 x 10,795 support-space checks. After: written proof, equality conditions, exact 32-root quadratic model and 127-hyperplane corroboration; separate root reconstruction checks all 10,795 canonical six-spaces against 120 punctures.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, eleven behavioral source/hypothesis controls, applicable Ruff rules and formatting pass. All 15 scientific committed/export bytes match; official export integrity and actual read-only Git-free optimized CPython 3.13 replay pass.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/d6-punctured-capacity 18`.
- Designated internal read-only peer evidence is retained in REVIEW.json. This is not human or proof-kernel approval. Historical 896-fiber census, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun.
- Canonical baseline 463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a, priority revision 6. Scientific commit 32d47dce276492ec5e9816d9e1afcedfc28fb4e9. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19004017).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Isolated research proof and replay package.

**Blast Radius:** research. Existing sources, shared tooling and selected frontier are unchanged.
